general_summary: Menos é Mais Arquitectos is the office created in Oporto in 1994 by Cristina Guedes and Francisco Vieira de Campos. Both graduated from Oporto School (FAUP), Cristina Guedes worked with Álvaro Siza (1991) and Francisco Vieira de Campos with Eduardo Souto de Moura (1989-1991). They both teach, CG (FAULP) and FVC (FAUP), and have been invited for the final critics at Mendrisio Architecture Academy, ETH Zurich and several portuguese and spanish universities. They have been invited for international lectures, workshops and seminars at Nancy, Mantua, Dubrovnik, Zagreb, Valencia and Bochum, and have also taken part in national award juries. Cristina Guedes acted as Commissary of Portugal at the IX BIAU New geographies. Published in Portugal and abroad, their work has been distinguished with various awards: Best Of Wine Tourism 2013 with Quinta do Vallado Hotel, Best Private Architectural Project 2012 with Quinta do Vallado Winery, and the VIII BIAU award with the Gaia Cablecar and received several nominations such as finalist of Premis FAD, honourable mentions at the Douro Architecture Award, shortlist of the Mies van Der Rohe Award, Architecture Award in the V and VI BIAU, shortlist at Secil Award. They took part in national and international exhibits such as VIII BIAU – Cádiz, Seville, Lisbon, Panamá and Washington, Porto Poetic - Milan, PREMIS FAD - Barcelona, 34th World Congress Of Vine And Wine - Oporto, Lisbon Architecture Triennale - Lisbon, Mies van der Rohe Award Exhibition - Barcelona, 7th International Architecture Biennial - São Paulo, Portugal Now - New York, VI BIAU - Lisbon, V BIAU - Montevideo, Individual Exhibit Site Meeting #3 Theme: Industry - Oporto, and 9th Architecture Biennial - Venice.

general_summary: Pedro Cabrito and Isabel Diniz are working together since 2000, in their studio based in Lisbon. Their work combines formal and spatial experimentation with extreme constructive rigor and an ethic of sustainability in the choice and use of materials. This attitude is present in the numerous large scale exhibition projects completed over the last few years where their approach has been strongly influenced by neo-objectual art.The architectural practice of Pedro Cabrito + Isabel Diniz is thus characterized by processes of formalization based on a constant relationship with the images, stimuli and materiality of everyday life, without any language restriction, emphasizing its metaphorical and poetic value.

general_summary: OITOEMPONTO was founded in 1993 by Artur Miranda, who was joined by Jacques Bec in 1995. It has combined the talent of two creators with completely different roots. After living in Sweden for seven years, Artur returned to Portugal with the Scandinavian influence coursing through his veins, associated with his previous experience in the fashion world, after graduating from the Escola Árvore school. Jacques is from France and studied at ESAG Met de Penninghen. He is naturally fascinated by the ornamental richness of the 19th century, new ideas in interior design, architecture and even lifestyle. Artur is the man of action while Jacques is the perfectionist.
